author: Nerdstalgic
description:
Broken Lizard created one of the most quotable cult comedies ever made, Super Troopers. Against all odds, five college friends turned a shoestring-budget indie into a DVD phenomenon that helped define comedy for an entire generation. But despite follow-ups like Club Dread and Beerfest, the comedy team never became the mainstream powerhouse many expected.

From Crowd Funded Sequels, Low Rent Follow Ups, and the future of Super Troopers 3, Broken Lizard never reached the next level of major mainstream success.   But why?

#supertroopers #cultcomedy #beerfest #improvcomedy
title: Why Broken Lizard Never Escaped Super Troopers
